definitions.explanation: The player with the highest batting average in a league or season. An important statistical title in professional baseball.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}は{誰|だれ}だろう。
examples.english: I wonder who this year's batting champion will be.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{三年|さんねん}{連続|れんぞく}で{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}に{輝|かがや}いた。
examples.english: He won the batting title for three consecutive years.

examples.japanese: {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}{争|あらそ}いが{終盤|しゅうばん}まで{続|つづ}き、{最後|さいご}の{試合|しあい}まで{目|め}が{離|はな}せなかった。
examples.english: The batting title race continued until the final stretch, and you couldn't take your eyes off the last game.

notes:
Combines {首位|しゅい} (first place, top position) and {打者|だしゃ} (batter, hitter). A prestigious individual title in Japanese professional baseball ({日本|にほん}プロ{野球|やきゅう}), awarded to the player with the highest batting average who meets the minimum plate appearance requirement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}{争|あらそ}い: batting title race
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}に{輝|かがや}く: to win the batting title
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}を{獲得|かくとく}する: to capture the batting title
- {通算|つうさん}{首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}: career batting title count

RELATED WORDS:
- {打率|だりつ}: batting average
- {本塁打|ほんるいだ}{王|おう}: home run king
- {打点|だてん}{王|おう}: RBI leader
- {最多|さいた}{安打|あんだ}: most hits
